title.en: MALACAÑAN PALACE BY THE PRESIDENT OF THE PHILIPPINES "REENGINEERING THE OFFICE OF THE PRESIDENT TOWARDS GREATER RESPONSIVENESS TO THE ATTAINMENT DEVELOPMENT GOALS," AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES

text.en:
Section 1 of EO No. 1 is hereby amended to read as follows:
"Section 1. Agency Supervision. The Cabinet Secretary shall have supervision over
the following agencies:
a. Cooperative Development Authority
b. National Anti-Poverty Commission
c. National Commission on Indigenous Peoples
d. National Commission on Muslim Filipinos
e. National Youth Commission
Office of the President-Presidential Complaint Center
g. Philippine Commission on Women
h. Presidential Commission on the Urban Poor
i. Technical Education and Skills Development Authority
With the supervision of the Cabinet Secretary, these agencies shall primarily
evaluate existing poverty reduction programs and, if deemed necessary, formulate
a more responsive set of programs complementing existing ones, channeling
resources as necessary to reduce both the incidence and magnitude of poverty.
They shall develop specific programs and projects that seek to reduce poverty,
improve the lives of the most vulnerable sectors of society; promote social
education of the people to allow them to participate in effecting real change by
keeping watch of the affairs of the government; and listen to people's feedback.
They shall conduct consultations with LGUs for the proper allocation of
resources and program implementation and recommend courses of action for the
government to adopt in order to achieve a sustainable system of meeting the needs
of the people, while ensuring resiliency for vulnerable communities.

Except for the foregoing amendments, all other provisions of EO No. 1 shall remain

The supervision over the NFA, PCA and FPA is hereby transferred to
the DA. Further, the OP shall continue to exercise immediate control and supervision over

The Secretary of the Department of Social Welfare and

representative
The Governor of the Bangko Sentral ng Pilipinas, or his duly
authorized permanent representative
The President of the Land Bank of the Philippines, or his duly
authorized permanent representative
A Farmers' Sector Representative to be appointed by the

All issuances, orders, rules and regulations, or parts thereof, which
are inconsistent with this Order are hereby repealed, amended or modified accordingly.

If any section or part of this Order is held unconstitutional or invalid,
the other sections or provisions not otherwise affected shall remain in full force or effect.

This Executive Order shall take effect immediately.
DONE, in the City of Manila, this 17th of September
